''See also: [[Blood aura Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Blood aura is a legendary and potent power associated with the [[Arelius bloodline]]. It is characterized by its ability to directly influence living flesh, making it exceptionally effective at causing physical damage or tearing bodies apart. When combined with other elements, such as [[fire madra]], it can cause flesh to burn like dry wood, and when blended with [[sword aura]] or [[hunger madra]], it creates complex and destructive techniques. The power is so intense that it can distort light or saturate the atmosphere, turning the air red and overwhelming a person's spiritual senses. This aura is closely linked to the [[Blood Shadow]], a [[spiritual parasite]] or manifestation that can be fed with blood aura, [[Life aura|life aura]], and [[soulfire]] to grow in strength, personality, and physical resemblance to its host. It can even take on the characteristics of powerful creatures if fed specific types of blood. Blood aura is also a fundamental component in the formation of [[Bloodspawn|bloodspawn]]—entities that rise from spilled blood and consume [[madra]]. While it can be used for healing and strengthening the body's muscles and bones, it is also a volatile force that can be used in high-level [[Ruler techniques]] to manipulate the physical world and combatants directly.}}
